note: MVS-style quest content for MIA. name = the real task (stays calm in sections); epic_name = the game voice (used in announcements, quest cards, and voice). rarity is computed from XP in the exporter. bonus_tasks are extra completions announced with the mission.
xp_note: Dailies run 20-60 XP; weeklies 100-200. Borderlands-flavored rarity: Common <50, Uncommon 50-99, Rare 100-199, Epic 200-349, Legendary 350+.
